thread:
zoe (PM): quick sync — GammaCorp on Dedicated reported SLA regressions after the new batching defaults. they want a fast ETA. options: hot revert, per-tenant cap, or roadmap tuning. who can triage now? cc @kai @sam

kai (Eng): pulling logs. initial staging repro shows timeouts when batch_size >= 12. likely an infra pressure + kv-cache growth for longer sequences.

anya (ML): model-side note: larger batches increase KV cache churn for long contexts which can blow memory on some GPU configs. tuning could take a few days.

sam (SRE): logs: `ERROR embed-svc req_id=gz9 timeout=102s batch=16`. I'll add a monitoring alert and see tenant-level traffic.

mike (CS): GammaCorp is on an annual SLA; they want an interim fix fast and a roadmap date for a robust solution.

zoe (PM): recommendation: ship a per-tenant soft cap behind a feature flag (fast, low risk) + create an epic for robustness (quantization, kv-cache sizing, evals). agree?

kai (Eng): agree. I can push a cap + tenant override (guarded) — PR ~45m. will include telemetry for noisy tenants.

sam (SRE): once PR is up I'll wire the flag into our infra and schedule a canary. also add p95/p99 alerts scoped to Dedicated pools.

mike (CS): GammaCorp will accept the soft cap if ETA < 2h. please confirm timeline so I can message them.

zoe (PM): plan: kai -> PR & canary; sam -> infra rollout & alerts; anya -> start robustness epic spec RDW-789; mike -> customer comms. owners assigned.

kai (Eng): PR: https://github.com/redwood/embed-service/pull/678 — adds per-tenant batch cap + feature flag. requesting @sam review.

sam (SRE): quick staging test: batch=16 -> 100s, batch=8 -> 24s. cap=8 looks safe. approving PR.

ops-bot: Canary deploy scheduled by @kai at 1976654380. Monitor channel: #incidents-embeddings

kai (Eng): kicking canary now.

sam (SRE): canary healthy after 10m. p95 down to expected levels; no timeouts on GammaCorp sample traffic. rolling to other Dedicated regions.

zoe (PM): :white_check_mark: mitigation deployed. creating RDW-789 "Embeddings robustness" for longer-term fixes (quantization, kv-cache, sequence heuristics). owners: anya (ML), kai (ENG), sam (SRE), zoe (PM).

mike (CS): told GammaCorp cap deployed and SLA metrics restored — they want a demo when RDW-789 shows progress. I'll coordinate dates.

anya (ML): I'll sketch a 3-day spike plan for RDW-789 covering evals and perf knobs.

kai (Eng): will add small experiments to the epic and estimate work for next grooming. also proposing a small support UI for tenant caps with audit logs.

zoe (PM): closing thread: short-term cap in place until robustness work delivered; customer comms in flight; RDW-789 on the backlog for prioritization. thanks team.

(roots: 1976654321, canary start 1976654380, follow-ups through 1976654550)
